name: Celebration
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Celebration, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Celebration, Florida for 2026: the Town Center tree lighting, Now Snowing nightly and a library Winterfest, checked on host sites.
lede: Celebration turns its Town Center into a snowy winter scene from November 28, with a tree lighting kickoff and a snowfall every night through December 31.
celebrates: Celebration, the Osceola County town Disney began developing in 1994, is known for its Christmas snow. Celebration Town Center opens its 28th Annual Now Snowing season with a free tree lighting on Saturday, November 28, with the first snowfall at 6 pm along Market Street. Snow then falls nightly from November 28 to December 31, and the Town Center lists Santa photos, ice skating, wagon rides and train rides as paid extras. The Osceola Library System adds West O Winterfest at the West Osceola Branch Library on December 15, with crafts and a book exchange.
lastyear: Celebration Town Center calls the 2026 season its 28th annual Now Snowing, which makes last year's season the 27th. The 2026 kickoff is a free tree lighting on Saturday, November 28, with festivities from 5:30 pm, the countdown at 5:55 pm and the first snowfall of the season at 6 pm, followed by snow nightly at 5:30 pm through December 31. Admission and parking are free, according to the Town Center, and Santa photos, rides and skating are paid extras.
facts: Celebration was developed by the Walt Disney Company, and its Town Center holds shops, restaurants and 106 residences, according to Wikipedia. The 2020 census counted 11,178 residents. Wikipedia describes the downtown events for the fall and Christmas seasons as releasing autumn leaves and snow made of small soap flakes into the Town Center, and the Town Center's own Now Snowing page calls its snow event Central Florida's original and premier family friendly snowing event.
trains: We did not find a full Christmas train ride attraction in Celebration, and we only list rides we can verify on a host page. The Celebration Town Center Now Snowing page lists train rides for $10 per person among its paid extras, alongside ice skating, wagon rides and Santa photos. Our Florida Christmas train rides guide collects the closest holiday train rides across the state for a longer day out.
traditions: Town Center's kickoff on November 28 with the countdown at 5:55 pm and the first snowfall at 6 pm.
Snow along Market Street every night from November 28 to December 31 at 5:30 pm.
Paid extras listed by the Town Center, including train rides at $10 and wagon rides at $7 per person.
The library's December 15 evening of winter crafts, snacks and a book exchange.
kidfact: The snow in Celebration is made of tiny soap flakes released into the Town Center, and it falls every night from November 28 to December 31.
faq: Celebration Town Center lights its tree on November 28 and then makes snow every night through December 31. The West Osceola Branch Library adds West O Winterfest on December 15.
Is Now Snowing in Celebration free?
Admission and parking are free, according to the Town Center. Santa photos, ice skating at $15, wagon rides at $7 per person and train rides at $10 per person cost extra.
When does the snow start each night?
The Now Snowing Nightly page lists 5:30 pm, and the tree lighting night puts the first snowfall at 6 pm.
Celebration Town Center, 701 Front Street, Celebration, FL 34747, on Saturday, November 28.
Celebration is a separate community in Osceola County. Margaritaville's Holiday Nights at Sunset Walk is in Kissimmee, not Celebration, so it appears on our Kissimmee page.
note: Holiday Nights Celebration (Promenade at Sunset Walk, 3251 Margaritaville Blvd, Kissimmee 34747) is a Kissimmee address and stays on kissimmee-fl.
